paragraphs: International gold is at $4,117 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.05 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,719/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (6 headlines), Inflation (5 headlines), Geopolitics and safe-haven buying (1 headline), Indian demand (1 headline).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Price Forecast: High Treasury Yields Put $4,000 Support in Focus (FXEmpire); Gold prices declined amid cautious anticipation of the Federal Reserve meeting and US inflation data (صوت الإمارات).

Inflation. Gold is held as an inflation hedge, though hot inflation can also mean higher rates, which cuts the other way. In the news: Gold prices declined amid cautious anticipation of the Federal Reserve meeting and US inflation data (صوت الإمارات); Gold Prices Fall for Third Session as Oil-Driven Inflation Concerns Shift Focus to Fed Rates (Yahoo Finance).
Geopolitics and safe-haven buying. Uncertainty sends investors to gold as a store of value. In the news: Gold prices decline while silver gains amid market uncertainty (AzerNews).
